plan_review.notes: Adversarial review forked the design. (1 blocking) affinity=Alt1 fixed 3-item bundle (Common+Uncommon+Rare), per-rarity independent alignment roll at exact 25/50/75 via a pure helper testable at thresholds; Reading A rejected (9.375% empty + not directly testable). (2 blocking) atomic bundle->bag ownership TRANSFER, not addGeneratedEquipmentToBag (bundles are owners, would always conflict). (3 blocking) prebuild everything then no-throw commit for registry+bundle. (4 major) private registry transaction with live-state clone + atomic swap, NOT public initialOrdinal (would violate restore's empty-registry/contiguous-ordinal invariant). (5 major) capacity-validated validate-then-commit claim. (6 major) carryover bundle-map moved to immediately after registry restore, before bag/equipped. (7 major) carryover semantic validation: achievement exists + reward.type==='equipment'. (8 major) curate reward bases so Common has no non-armor statBonus; budget-driven Uncommon(1)/Rare(2); no global-policy/DPS-gate change. (9 major) fail-closed unlock when Floor2 economy access.kind!=='enabled'; reuse existing bundle (idempotent). (10 minor) per-rarity RNG substreams w/ resolver version; narrowed generator world type; canonical WeaponType.MAGIC?magic:physical affinity; UI equipment-reward presentation + claim result exposes resolved items.

rounds.notes: Two Medium findings, both fixed in 29859b524. (A) A stale/tampered persisted bundle (empty, wrong count, or wrong per-index rarity) was neither rejected on carryover load nor on claim, so an empty bundle could be 'claimed' as success and permanently consume the reward -> added fail-closed exactly-3-instances-in-Common/Uncommon/Rare-order guards to BOTH playerCarryover.validateGeneratedCarryover and equipmentSystem.claimGeneratedEquipmentRewardBundle, using a new shared canonical-order constant. (B) A globally-valid non-default generation policy (per-rarity budget in [0,2]) could violate the reward rarity contract -> resolver now fails closed with illegal-effect-budget when the ambient policy exceeds {common:0,uncommon:1,rare:2}. Regression tests added for every guard; verify:fast + full integration project green.

Distinct-model reviewers over git diff 6162b732..HEAD. gemini-3.1-pro-preview: CLEAN, no findings. claude-sonnet-4.6: one High/CI-breaker — the new carryover semantic guard rejected the pre-existing integration test tests/integration/floor-transition-carryover.test.ts (synthetic single-instance bundle 'floor-transition-reward'); verify:fast missed it because it skips the integration project. Adjudication (claude-opus-4.8): valid CI-breaker AND, combined with the round-1 shape guard, the test bundle also violated the new exactly-3-instances contract. Fixed in 29859b524 by rebuilding it (and the analogous pre-existing unit carryover test) as a well-formed Common/Uncommon/Rare bundle under the real unlocked floor2-field-kit achievement, and extending the fixture with a rarity param. Re-ran the full integration project (163 tests) green to confirm no other guard-triggered breakage.
